guitar.notes: Confirmed — Louis Bertignac is well known in French rock for SG and Telecaster usage; medium confidence appropriate given two guitarists and varied gear.

tone.target: raw French new-wave crunch with slight fuzz
tone.profile: raw French new-wave crunch with slight fuzz
tone.summary: A tight, mid-focused signal chain using an OD boost (Green OD) into a UK 45 amp model, complemented by light Fuzz and minimal Chorus to achieve the raw French new-wave tone.

rig.name: Téléphone - La Bombe Humaine - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight riff definition.
Provide the initial 'dirty riff drive' and tighten the low end without excessive grit.
blocks.gap: The source suggests a Tube Screamer, but Green OD is the closest available mid-focused boost for this genre.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if more vintage warmth is desired)

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required 'slight fuzz' subtly without sounding overly psychedelic or muddy.
blocks.gap: The requirement is for a subtle, controlled fuzz, which requires careful dialing of the Fuzz module to avoid excessive saturation.

alternatives.model: Red Haze (if more aggressive grit is needed)

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No wah needed for this specific New Wave tone).
Simulate the 'Plexi/Marshall crunch' and small combo sound, providing classic British bite.

alternatives.model: UK 50 (if a slightly cleaner tone is preferred)

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet tone that complements the UK 45 amp model.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (if a slightly more open sound is desired)

blocks.purpose: Apply the 'slight chorus' effect minimally to add width and movement without sounding washed out.
blocks.gap: The requirement is for minimal modulation, so settings are kept low.

alternatives.model: Tremolo (if a rhythmic pulsing effect is needed)

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space without the 'washed delay' effect.
blocks.gap: The goal is subtlety, so feedback and mix are kept very low.

alternatives.model: Tape (if a warmer, less defined echo is preferred)

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural, non-intrusive ambience to ground the sound.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more defined, metallic reverb is desired)

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic British combo sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the small combo feel and vintage bite of the UK 45 amp model.
